page_title: GET 0-1 RMA | Getafe v Real Madrid 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+7' Coba da Costa (Getafe) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Thibaut Courtois anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
90+5' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+4' Diego Rico (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
90+3' That's unlucky! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Coba da Costa (Getafe) will replace Adrian Liso.
90' A pass into space is latched onto by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid), and he bends a shot just wide of the right post that had the keeper worried.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Martin departs the field of play to be replaced by Abu Kamara (Getafe).
86' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Rodrygo and he is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) replaces Jude Bellingham.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
84' Jose Munuera blows his whistle and Alex Sancris (Getafe) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
83' The Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

80' 0 - 1 Arda Guler produces a killer pass to release Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who then unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 0:1!
79' Jose Bordalas Jimenez appears to have said too much and referee Jose Munuera comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
79' The ref’s original red card decision for Allan Nyom (Getafe) is upheld after a VAR review!

78' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Allan Nyom (Getafe), but referee Jose Munuera must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
77' What an awful challenge. The referee Jose Munuera has no other option than to send Allan Nyom (Getafe) off the pitch. Red card!
76' Kiko Femenia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
75' Great individual play by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the right post.
74' The foul by Alex Sancris (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.
73' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
72' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post.
71' Djene (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Real Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
69' What a miskick by Djene (Getafe). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
67' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
66' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece.

66' Nice move, nice attempt! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
65' The substitution is prepared. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eduardo Camavinga.

64' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
63' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Munuera ignores the protests.
60' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
60' The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
60' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
59' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
58' Djene (Getafe) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Munuera signals.
57' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

57' Adrian Liso (Getafe) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Getafe.
55' Franco Mastantuono goes off the pitch and Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) comes on.
55' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
54' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
52' Adrian Liso (Getafe) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
51' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
51' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
51' Djene (Getafe) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
50' Djene (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
48' A yellow card for a tackle by Domingos Duarte (Getafe). Jose Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Adrian Liso (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game is over for David Alaba (Real Madrid). Raul Asencio comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes a snap shot from outside the box. His effort curls way wide of the left post.
45+2' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
45+2' David Alaba (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at David Soria.
45+1' Jose Munuera blows his whistle. Diego Rico (Getafe) commits a foul after dangerous play. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot to the top of the net, but the keeper denies him.
42' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
39' Alex Sancris (Getafe) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Thibaut Courtois scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Foul! Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
37' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
34' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.

32' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes one touch to control a lofted pass and makes some space to unleash a long-range low drive. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal but fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about, allowing him to make a comfortable save.
29' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid).
29' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Real Madrid have a corner.
28' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
28' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
26' Luis Milla (Getafe) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
25' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Jose Munuera immediately signals a free kick.
25' Luis Milla (Getafe) touches the ball with his hand.
24' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Getafe! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Jose Munuera and both teams have no complaints.

23' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Getafe.
23' Alex Sancris (Getafe) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
21' Jose Munuera blows for a foul after Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
18' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid).
17' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
15' The players claim that Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
10' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.
9' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
8' Great touch by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
6' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
6' Adrian Liso (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
4' The foul by Adrian Liso (Getafe) was seen by Jose Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' The linesman signals that Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' Mario Martin (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Jose Munuera stops the game and makes a call.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will officiate today.
